text:
Hi there, and thank you for contacting Leafy! 🌿 Happy to help with this one.

**You have 2 hours from the time you place your order** to cancel or change it for free. Here's how:

- Go to **"My Orders"** on the website or app
- Select the order and cancel or make your changes

**If more than 2 hours have passed:**
- Your order moves into our packing queue and can't be changed online.
- Our support team can try to intercept it before it ships, but I can't guarantee that it will work.
- Once an order has shipped, it can't be cancelled, and the shipping address can't be changed either.

If you're past the 2-hour window, just let me know your order number (it looks like LF- followed by six digits) and I can help with next steps. Also, if you've cancelled and see a pending charge on your card, it usually drops off within 3-7 business days, depending on your bank.

Is there an order you're trying to cancel right now? I'm happy to help however I can. 😊
